_guide.jumpPercent: Percent change per shade step from center.
_guide.snapCount: Number of slider stops including -100 and +100.
_guide.autoBrightnessShade: Direction/position on shade scale: -100 means toward white, +100 means toward black.
_guide.maxBlendPercent: Maximum blend strength at |shade|=100. Example: 40 means blend up to 40% toward white/black.
_guide.presetShadeDefaults: Default shade by preset. Background/buildPlate use white/black/modelcolor/custom. Model presets use preset ids from presets.json (e.g., ceramic, ink).
_guide.shadeResponse: Optional perceptual tuning. Lower lightenScale reduces intensity on the lighter side (0 to -25).
